deadline.value: Priority review deadline for Fall admission is January 1, 2027; later materials are considered on a space-available basis.
deadline.quote: The priority review deadline for all application materials is January 1st for Summer or Fall admission | Application materials submitted after the deadlines may be considered on a space-available basis

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required, but will be considered if sent.
gre_general.quote: GRE Scores are not required for the application or admission to the WVU Biology graduate programs, but will be considered if they are provided

gre_subject.value: GRE scores are not required, so no subject test is needed.
gre_subject.quote: GRE Scores are not required for the application or admission to the WVU Biology graduate programs, but will be considered if they are provided

supervisor.value: A faculty member must agree to advise the applicant, or the applicant is not admitted.
supervisor.quote: If after reviewing all the application materials there is no faculty member willing to serve as the applicant's academic advisor, then the potential student will not be accepted into the program

funding.value: Fall and Summer applicants received by the deadline are considered for a GTA; no guarantee is stated.
funding.quote: Fall and Summer applications received by the deadline will be considered for financial support in the form of a graduate teaching assistantship (GTA)

entry_route.value: The program admits students directly to the master's or doctoral degree from a bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: The Biology program admits students directly to either the masters or doctoral degree programs

toefl_min.value: The page gives only an old-scale iBT figure (over 100), so no TOEFL minimum is recorded here.
toefl_min.quote: greater than 100 for the internet-based test

notes: Department says it likes to see IELTS above 7.0 and Duolingo above 120; these are preferences, not stated minimums. Admission is by vote of the Graduate Committee.
